title: 버스와 택시: 타다, 내리다, 교통카드
objective: By the end, you can use words like 타다, 내리다, 갈아타다, and 교통카드 in short sentences about riding a bus or taxi, with the right particle (버스를 타다, 버스에서 내리다).
summary: Ten everyday words for getting on, getting off, and paying on buses and taxis in Korea.

task.title: Use the transport words
task.line: Use the words above to choose, fill in, or put each sentence in order.

words.meaning: to get on, to take (a bus, taxi)
words.exampleMeaning: I take the bus when I go to school.
Get off in front of City Hall.

words.meaning: to transfer, to change (to another bus or line)
words.exampleMeaning: I transfer to the subway at Jongno.
It was raining, so I called a taxi.
Does this bus go to Gangnam Station?
I waited at the bus stop for 10 minutes.
I left my transit card at home.

words.meaning: to tap (a card on the reader)
words.exampleMeaning: Tap your card when you get off, too.

words.meaning: driver (polite way to address a bus or taxi driver)
fare (the money you pay for a ride)
words.exampleMeaning: The taxi fare came out high.

exercises: Choose the right particle: ① 어제 택시(를 / 에서) 탔어요. ② 친구가 버스(를 / 에서) 내렸어요.
Fill in the blank with a verb from the list: 버스에 타면 교통카드를 ____어야 해요.
Choose 정류장 or 요금 for each blank: ① 버스 ____이 어디에 있어요? ② 버스 ____은 얼마예요?
You are in a taxi and want to get out here. Fill in the word you use to call the driver: ____, 여기서 내릴게요.
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 갈아타요 / 시청에서 / 버스로
answers: 시청에서 버스로 갈아타요. (or: 버스로 시청에서 갈아타요.)
